candidates.premise: Fresh pineapple can sabotage a gelatin dessert; canned pineapple has been heat treated.
candidates.evidence: UGA lesson explains failure to solidify with fresh/frozen pineapple and enzyme inactivation during canning. Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics identifies bromelain, gelatin protein breakdown and canned-pineapple use.
candidates.media: Original local Blender gelatin illustration; original animated protein-network/scissors metaphor, not a molecular simulation, measured experiment or cooked result.

candidates.premise: An 8-to-10-inch round pan swap increases diameter 25% but base area 56.25%; same batter depth requires attention to recipe and pan geometry.
candidates.evidence: King Arthur explains round pan area using radius squared times pi and requires pan depth context. Our nominal-area ratio is(10/8)^2=1.5625. No source photography or article text copied.
candidates.media: Original proportionally drawn vector geometry; no real pans measured or actual cake yield claimed.

selection.directorReason: The pineapple premise and original pink/lilac gelatin material offer a more distinctive entertainment/science slot. Pan circles are useful but ordinary; do not expand into filler.
